No amount is invented.

rows.defectReproduced: participant-instructions.md carried no fee, cost, charge or payment statement anywhere: no amount, no statement that the request is free, and no office to ask. Confirmed here by reading the whole file. I also read the source itself rather than the packet's extraction of it: the pinned DJ-LE-250B bytes (SHA-256 3c5d4806ff1061246ec06c93716cfa80ec3d61b9e21c5c79639114ab1e5454b6, re-hashed from the Master Library in this container) were rendered to page images at 110 and 130 dpi and read directly, and neither the Bureau's instruction page nor the request page says anything about a fee, a cost or a payment. So the verifier's finding stands in both directions: nothing is likely charged, and the packet nowhere said so.
rows.controllingStandard: data/rcap-grade-a/fable-packet-factory/DETERMINATION_FEE_AND_WAIVER_STANDARD.json. Of its three ways to meet the obligation, only the third is honest here — no held source establishes a fee, a no-fee rule or a waiver — so the packet states the open question and names a specific checkable authority.
rows.repairsMade: One section added to the family's participant-instructions.md, through the instruction generator in the family's owning script scripts/build-census-v1-wi_nc_doj_fingerprint_removal-set.mjs (the generated file was not hand-edited). It states plainly that neither page of DJ-LE-250B says anything about cost and that no held source states a fee, a no-fee rule or a waiver; that silence on the form is not the same as a rule that the request is free; and that the participant should ask the Crime Information Bureau of the Wisconsin Department of Justice, Criminal History Unit — the same office the request is sent to — whether any fee applies and whether it can be waived, before sending. It points the participant at the Bureau's mailing address printed in instruction 1 on page 1 of the form they are holding, rather than retyping it, because instruction 1 is set in the subsetted font this build refuses to un-shift; that refusal is the family's own recorded discipline (reports/caption-evidence.json) and this repair keeps it.
rows.nothingInvented: No amount is stated. It is NOT claimed that the request is free — neither is established by any held source. Nothing outside the fee section changed.
